total-time-remaining.description: At current state of energy, total time before all backed-up loads go unpowered.

time-to-priority-shed.description: At current state of energy, time until priority-shed (e.g. `SOC_THRESHOLD`) circuits are auto-shed.

full-charge-total-time-remaining.description: At 100% state of energy, total backup-duration capability.

full-charge-time-to-priority-shed.description: At 100% state of energy, capability time until the priority-shed event.

confidence.description: The algorithm's self-assessed confidence: `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`. Reflects accumulated usage history.
